trailhead.label: Top station of the Mont Sëuc cable car from Ortisei, the board’s start

cautions: Cows graze the Alpe di Siusi in summer: keep your dog close and give herds a wide berth.
About a quarter is on a service road used by hut traffic.
Open, high meadows at 1,900–2,000 m: little shade on sunny days.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
